summary: Defines a framework for coupling the Active Queue Management algorithms of two queues, for flows that respond to congestion differently. It offers a path for the Internet to move from classic Reno-friendly congestion control to scalable congestion control with very low queuing delay. It is an experimental specification.

eli5.summary: Two lines at a shop, one for gentle shoppers and one for pushy ones, are linked so both get a fair turn and the gentle line stays quick.
